fields.title: 7. Proposed new rules — none
fields.md:
`count_milestone_early` is not a new adjustment rule. It fixes how the existing early-achievement rule is read when applied to count milestones, and it has no effect on probabilities. The R2 trigger follows the existing rule (+5/−5) unchanged. The existing proposals ①–⑤ are kept (source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
